title: Senior Backend Engineer, Ruby
description_html:
GitLab is an all-remote company and you can work from anywhere in the world. We are hiring a Senior Backend Engineer to build scalable APIs in Ruby on Rails backed by PostgreSQL and Redis, deployed on AWS with Kubernetes.

Compensation

The base salary range for this role is $119,900.00 to $193,200.00 USD.

Benefits

  • Home office budget and equipment stipend
  • Learning budget for courses and certifications
  • Health insurance and a retirement plan (401k)
  • Unlimited PTO

title: Frontend Engineer (React)
description_html:

Salary: $90,000 to $150,000 USD depending on experience.

title: Fullstack Engineer
description_html:
